subtitle: Project Lead, AI Department · HawarIT Limited

rows.body: Geospatial AI; 3D scene understanding and point cloud analytics; urban reconstruction and digital twins; autonomous GIS workflows and spatiotemporal change detection.

B.Sc. in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
Islamic University of Technology (IUT), Bangladesh.
CGPA: 3.76/4.00, first class honours.

rows.label: Thesis
rows.body: Quantifying Locomotive Features in EEG of Impaired Consciousness (Coma) with Distinctive Cerebral Rhythms. Analyzed EEG time series and cerebral rhythms. A+ in Project and Thesis courses. IUT repository.

Tasnim Sakib Apon, Mohammad Mahmudul Hasan, Abrar Islam, and Md. Golam Rabiul Alam. “Demystifying Deep Learning Models for Retinal OCT Disease Classification using Explainable AI.” 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (CSDE).
DOI: 10.1109/CSDE53843.2021.9718400 · Author preprint.

rows.label: 2024–Present
rows.body:
Project Lead, AI Department · HawarIT Limited.
Lead multidisciplinary teams delivering AI and geospatial automation systems.

Senior AI Engineer · HawarIT Limited.
Developed AI systems for photogrammetry, point cloud analytics, and spatial automation.

ML Engineer · HawarIT Limited.
Built machine learning and computer vision pipelines for geospatial applications.

rows.label: Point clouds
rows.body: Developed LiDAR semantic segmentation and automated pipe/geometry extraction across aerial, mobile, and indoor datasets: 95% extraction accuracy and 60% less manual processing time.

rows.label: Change detection
rows.body: Developed multi-temporal building change detection and integrated GIS validation: 88% accuracy and 65% less manual inspection.

rows.label: Orthophoto QA
rows.body: Automated cloud/shadow/blur assessment (97% accuracy), PostGIS/AHN seamline refinement (65% less editing), and camera alignment (2-pixel accuracy; 90% less manual aerial triangulation effort).

rows.label: Street-view GeoAI
rows.body: Developed YOLOv5 and tracking pipelines for 130 traffic sign and 33 street furniture classes: detection accuracy above 95% and localization precision of 92%.

rows.label: 3D city models
rows.body: Built CityGML reconstruction and occlusion-aware multi-view aerial texture projection, maintaining reported texture displacement below 3 pixels.

rows.label: Remote sensing
rows.body: Applied Sentinel multispectral analytics to crop classification, water quality, and algae bloom detection. The framework placed second in an international innovation tender.

rows.label: Programming
rows.body: Python, SQL, JavaScript, C, MATLAB, R.
Excellent Performer (2024); Borsho Shera, Best Performer of the Year (2022), HawarIT Limited.

rows.label: Selected awards
rows.body: 2nd place, International Innovation Tender; 1st place, MATLAB Competition, AUST; Top 15, Dhaka.AI Deep Learning Competition; 1st prize, Nuclear Power Seminar, AUST; Government Merit Scholarship, HSC.
